LESSON: REFORMS INTRODUCED BY PROPHET MUHAMMAD

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.1: Reforms introduced by Prophet Muhammad

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Reforms introduced by Prophet Muhammad. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain what Reforms introduced by Prophet Muhammad means in simple pupil language
2. give 3 correct examples of Reforms introduced by Prophet Muhammad from Kenya
3. practise Reforms introduced by Prophet Muhammad in clear steps
4. apply Reforms introduced by Prophet Muhammad in one real-life situation this week

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: REFORMS INTRODUCED BY PROPHET MUHAMMAD
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 7
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Reforms introduced by Prophet Muhammad helps you succeed in ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

PART 1: Explain what Reforms introduced by Prophet Muhammad means in simple pupil language

What this means
In this part you learn to explain what Reforms introduced by Prophet Muhammad means in simple pupil language. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain what Reforms introduced by Prophet Muhammad means in simple pupil language.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Reforms introduced by Prophet Muhammad” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain what Reforms introduced by Prophet Muhammad means in simple pupil language. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Reforms introduced by Prophet Muhammad is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Reforms introduced by Prophet Muhammad” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: explain what Reforms introduced by Prophet Muhammad means in simple pupil language)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Reforms introduced by Prophet Muhammad in your own words. (skill: give 3 correct examples of Reforms introduced by Prophet Muhammad from Kenya)

Example 3: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson. (skill: practise Reforms introduced by Prophet Muhammad in clear steps)

Example 4: Show how “Reforms introduced by Prophet Muhammad” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: apply Reforms introduced by Prophet Muhammad in one real-life situation this week)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Reforms introduced by Prophet Muhammad to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: explain what Reforms introduced by Prophet Muhammad means in simple pupil language.
3. Practise this skill: give 3 correct examples of Reforms introduced by Prophet Muhammad from Kenya.
4. Practise this skill: practise Reforms introduced by Prophet Muhammad in clear steps.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Reforms introduced by Prophet Muhammad from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Reforms introduced by Prophet Muhammad: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 7 learner study Reforms introduced by Prophet Muhammad?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Reforms introduced by Prophet Muhammad means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: explain what Reforms introduced by Prophet Muhammad means in simple pupil language.
5. Be able to: give 3 correct examples of Reforms introduced by Prophet Muhammad from Kenya.
